voice_principles: the practical word before the felt one
the mechanics of the visit carry the feeling
no emotion named that a gesture or a rule could imply
diction: the procedural vocabulary of a prison visit: search, stamp, locker, visiting order, the hall, the officer, the table
few adjectives, each earning its place
syntax: an occasional long sentence for one sustained action
rhythm: let a silence or a rule be an action, not a described feeling
imagery: the stamped hand, the plastic cup, the bolted furniture, the photo kept in a pocket
the phrase 'Mam sends her love' as the recurring load-bearing line
dialogue: the theme is never spoken; the one loaded beat is handled in as few words as possible
no adverbial tags; distinct idiolects (Lena dry and flat, Danny quicker and needier under a front)
avoid: sentimental prison-visit cliche (the single tear, the hands almost touching)
filter words (she felt / saw / realized / noticed / watched)
